Title: O3+ Peel Off Brazilian Wax For Easy Hair Removal On Sensitive Skin | 100 g
Highlights:
- Gentle on Sensitive Skin: O3+ Peel Off Wax is specially formulated to be gentle on even the most sensitive skin, minimising the risk of irritation and allergic reactions.
- Less Painful Application: The non-strip formula is applied in a thin layer, making the hair removal process less painful and more comfortable for the user.
- Effective Hair Removal: This facial wax without strips for women ensures superior hair removal, efficiently pulling out hair from the roots without causing redness or inflammation.
- Multi-purpose: This face wax for women is suitable for the face, underarms, bikini line, and legs, it offers a complete solution for all your hair removal needs.

Title: O3+ D-TAN Facial Kit for TAN Removal & Skin lightening 45g | Detan Facial Kit for TAN Removal
Highlights:
- Thoroughly cleans the skin: It gently exfoliates the skin, removes dead cells, eliminates excessive oil & revives sun-damaged skin.
- Keeps your skin hydrated: The d-Tan kit moisturizes the skin, evens skin tone, and provides an instant glow. It removes impurities, leaving behind youthful, clean & glowing skin.
- For all skin types: The offered O3+ D-tan Facial Kit With Peel Off Mask is an ideal solution for all skin types to have a flawless and seamless texture with whitening and brightening benefits every day.

Title: Garnier Vitamin C + Face Serum for Skin Brightening & Anti-Dark Spots, 30ml
Brand: Garnier
Highlights:
- Face serum suitable for all skin types
- Instantly combats a dull skin tone and reduces dark spots when used regularly
- How to use: Cleanse skin using a face wash, Apply 3-4 drops of serum and spread evenly over the face and neck using gentle tapping motions, Use twice a day and follow up with moisturising creams
- Enriched with lemon extracts and 30 times the amount of Vitamin C of Garnier's Bright Complete face creams to combat dark spots
- Contents: 1x Garnier Bright Complete Vitamin C Booster Face Serum, Volume: 30 ml

Title: Colgate Strong Teeth Calcium-Boost Toothpaste, 700g (175g X 4)
Brand: Colgate
Highlights:
- INDIA'S NO.1 TOOTHPASTE FOR STRONGER TEETH: COLGATE STRONG TEETH is trusted by families across India for delivering stronger teeth. As per Kantar Worldpanel Apr '23 report, it's the No.1 penetrated toothpaste in India, and has the highest volume share within the Toothpastes category
- PROTECTS ENAMEL: Nourished Teeth are important as our teeth are losing calcium every day we eat sugary or junk food, making enamel protection essential for dental health
- CALCIUM BOOST FORMULA: COLGATE STRONG TEETH NOURISHES teeth by boosting the process of natural calcium reabsorption from the saliva to restore depleted calcium levels
- 2X STRONGER TEETH: NOURISHED TEETH are 2X STRONGER with COLGATE STRONG TEETH's unique Calcium Boost + Arginine Formula that strengthens teeth from within
- COMPREHENSIVE ORAL CARE: STRENGTHENS TEETH, PREVENTS CAVITIES, Whitens Teeth and Freshens Breath with regular use for complete dental protection
- RECOMMENDED USAGE: Brush twice a day for 2 minutes each time for optimal results and maximum protection against cavities and enamel damage
- QUALITY INGREDIENTS: 100% VEGAN, Gluten-Free and responsibly made toothpaste suitable for the entire family including men, women and children
- VALUE PACK: Combo Multipack contains 700g total (175g X 4 tubes) providing long-lasting supply for your family's daily oral care needs

Title: Santoor Skin Moisturizing Sandal & Turmeric Bathing Soap with Nourishing & Anti-Aging Properties| For Soft & Smooth and Younger-Looking Skin| For All Skin Types| Pack of 8, 125g
Brand: SANTOOR
Highlights:
- Your Skin’s Best Friend: Santoor Skin Moisturizing Sandal & Turmeric Bathing Soap is infused with natural ingredients that gently cleanse and purify the skin, leaving it soft, smooth, and supple
- Nature’s Goodness: Sandal and turmeric are known for their healing properties. Sandalwood removes blemishes and smoothens skin, while Turmeric has antiseptic properties that protect the skin against acne
- Deep Moisturisation: Santoor Skin Moisturizing Sandal Soap is infused with natural moisturizing ingredients that deeply hydrate your skin and prevents dryness
- Luxurious Fragrance: Enjoy the refreshing and captivating scent of sandalwood that lingers on your skin throughout the day and enhances your bathing experience
- Radiant Complexion: The combination of sandalwood and turmeric helps improves skin tone, giving you a naturally youthful & glowing complexion
- Trusted Brand: Santoor is a trusted name for over 36 years in skincare and known for its commitment to quality and effectiveness

Title: INDUS VALLEY Damage Free Natural Gel Hair Colour for Women | Black 1.00 | Ammonia & PPD Free | 100% Grey Coverage | Long Lasting Conditioning Colour | 220 ml
Brand: INDUS VALLEY
Highlights:
- Minimizes Greys & Provides Natural-Looking Colour: This semi-permanent herbal hair colour is formulated without hydrogen peroxide (bleach) and helps reduce the appearance of grey hair while providing a natural-looking colour finish.
- Gentle, Herbal & Chemical-Free Formula: Made without ammonia, PPD, parabens, and resorcinol, this gentle hair colour is designed to help maintain soft, smooth, and healthy-looking hair.
- Complete Grey Hair Coverage in Just 35 Minutes: Specially formulated for grey and white hair, this PPD-free hair colour provides effective grey hair coverage in just 35 minutes, with colour lasting for up to 5 weeks.
- Enriched with 8 Nourishing Herbs: This herbal hair colour is infused with 8 carefully selected hair-care herbs and nourishing organic compounds to colour while caring for your hair.
- Vegan, Cruelty-Free & Dermatologist Recommended: A vegan and cruelty-free hair colour designed for a gentle colouring experience and recommended by dermatologists. Ideal for those looking for a herbal and PPD-free alternative for grey hair coverage.

Title: WILD STONE CODE Terra Eau De Parfum for Men, 100ml|Luxury Perfume with Long Lasting Smell for Classy, Mature and Sleek Personality|Premium Perfume for Men, Spray
Brand: WILD STONE CODE
Highlights:
- A special earthy fragrance that allows you to travel through time & space straight to the refreshing smell of petrichor. Connect to your origins with TERRA.
- Fragrance Attributes – Earthy, Mature & Warm
- Personality Notes – Classy & Sleek
- Top notes: Grapefruit and Orange; Heart notes: Black Pepper and Flint; Base notes: Oakmoss, Vetiver, Patchouli, Cedarwood, and Musk
- Directions to use: Keep the spray nozzle 3-6 inches away from the skin while applying. Apply on pulse points – wrists, behind ears, and neck
